heading: Liji 32 · Wen Sang 問喪 · Questions About Mourning Rites · Wen Sang 1 … Wen Sang 10

items.text: On your father's death, abstain from cooked food for three days, taking only gruel and rice-water provided by neighbors.
items.quote: for three days fire was not kindled... neighbours prepared for him gruel and rice-water

items.text: When the corpse is moved and the coffin lifted, wail and leap without number.
items.quote: At the moving of the corpse, and lifting up of the coffin, (the son) wailed and leaped, times without number.

items.text: As a daughter mourning a parent, wail, weep, beat your breast, and show deep sorrow.
items.quote: When a daughter wails, weeps, and is sad, beats her breast, and wounds her heart

items.text: Offer the sacrifice of repose in the ancestral temple, hoping your parent's shade may return to enjoy it.
items.quote: In presenting the sacrifice (of repose) in the (to his parent) ancestral temple... hoping that his shade would peradventure return
items.conflict: No offerings to the dead; God alone is worshipped (Deut 18:11; Luke 16:19-31)

items.text: After the burial, dwell in the mourning shed, sleep on rushes with a clod for your pillow, and do not return to your chamber.
items.quote: he did not venture to occupy his chamber, but dwelt in the mourning shed... He slept on the rushes, with a clod for his pillow

items.text: Endure mourning toil and grief for three full years.
items.quote: he endured the toil and grief for three years

items.text: While your father lives, do not use a staff in his presence or walk hastily in the hall.
items.quote: while his father is alive he does not dare to use a staff... Nor does he walk hastily in the hall

items.text: Use a black bamboo staff when mourning your father, and a square-cut elaeococcus staff when mourning your mother.
items.quote: for a father they used the black staff of bamboo; and for a mother, the square-cut staff, an elaeococcus branch

items.text: Wait three days before dressing the corpse, hoping your parent may revive.
items.quote: the dressing does not begin till after three days... waiting that time to see if (his father) will come to life

items.text: If you are the young representative of the family, wear the mourning cincture and carry the staff.
items.quote: if he had come to be the representative of the family, he wore the cincture, and carried the staff

items.text: As a son mourning a parent, wail and bow down until your forehead touches the ground, without regard to elegance.
items.quote: when a son wails, weeps, is sad, and bows down till his forehead touches the ground
